#!/bin/bash
# RNA-seq质量控制流程
# 作者: {{AUTHOR}}
# 日期: {{DATE}}

set -e

# 参数设置
THREADS=4
INPUT_DIR="data/raw"
OUTPUT_DIR="results/01_qc"

mkdir -p $OUTPUT_DIR

echo "=== 开始质量控制 ==="

# FastQC质控
echo "运行FastQC..."
fastqc -t $THREADS -o $OUTPUT_DIR $INPUT_DIR/*.fastq.gz

# MultiQC汇总
echo "生成MultiQC报告..."
multiqc $OUTPUT_DIR -o $OUTPUT_DIR

echo "=== 质量控制完成 ==="
echo "报告位置: $OUTPUT_DIR/multiqc_report.html"

#!/bin/bash
# RNA-seq数据修剪流程

set -e

THREADS=4
INPUT_DIR="data/raw"
OUTPUT_DIR="results/02_clean"
ADAPTER="TruSeq3-PE.fa"

mkdir -p $OUTPUT_DIR

echo "=== 开始数据修剪 ==="

# Trimmomatic修剪
for sample in $INPUT_DIR/*_R1.fastq.gz; do
    base=$(basename $sample _R1.fastq.gz)
    echo "处理样本: $base"
    
    trimmomatic PE -threads $THREADS \
        $INPUT_DIR/${base}_R1.fastq.gz $INPUT_DIR/${base}_R2.fastq.gz \
        $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_R1.clean.fastq.gz $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_R1.unpair.fastq.gz \
        $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_R2.clean.fastq.gz $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_R2.unpair.fastq.gz \
        ILLUMINACLIP:$ADAPTER:2:30:10 \
        LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:36
done

echo "=== 数据修剪完成 ==="

#!/bin/bash
# RNA-seq比对流程 (HISAT2)

set -e

THREADS=8
GENOME_INDEX="reference/hisat2_index/genome"
INPUT_DIR="results/02_clean"
OUTPUT_DIR="results/03_alignment"

mkdir -p $OUTPUT_DIR

echo "=== 开始序列比对 ==="

for sample in $INPUT_DIR/*_R1.clean.fastq.gz; do
    base=$(basename $sample _R1.clean.fastq.gz)
    echo "比对样本: $base"
    
    hisat2 -x $GENOME_INDEX \
        -1 $INPUT_DIR/${base}_R1.clean.fastq.gz \
        -2 $INPUT_DIR/${base}_R2.clean.fastq.gz \
        -S $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sam \
        --new-summary -p $THREADS 2> $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_align.log
    
    # SAM转BAM并排序
    samtools view -bS $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sam | \
        samtools sort -o $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sorted.bam
    samtools index $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sorted.bam
    
    # 统计比对率
    samtools flagstat $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sorted.bam > $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}_flagstat.txt
    
    # 删除SAM文件节省空间
    rm $OUTPUT_DIR/${base}.sam
done

echo "=== 序列比对完成 ==="

#!/bin/bash
# RNA-seq定量流程 (featureCounts)

set -e

THREADS=4
GTF="reference/annotation.gtf"
INPUT_DIR="results/03_alignment"
OUTPUT_DIR="results/04_quantification"

mkdir -p $OUTPUT_DIR

echo "=== 开始基因定量 ==="

# featureCounts定量
featureCounts -T $THREADS \
    -a $GTF \
    -o $OUTPUT_DIR/gene_counts.txt \
    -g gene_id \
    $INPUT_DIR/*.sorted.bam

echo "=== 基因定量完成 ==="
echo "计数文件: $OUTPUT_DIR/gene_counts.txt"

# 差异表达分析脚本 (DESeq2)
# 作者: {{AUTHOR}}
# 日期: {{DATE}}

library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# ========== 参数设置 ==========
COUNTS_FILE <- "results/04_quantification/gene_counts.txt"
METADATA_FILE <- "data/metadata.csv"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results/05_deg"
CONTRAST <- c("group", "treatment", "control")
PADJ_CUTOFF <- 0.05
LFC_CUTOFF <- 1

# ========== 读取数据 ==========
cat("读取数据...\n")

# 读取count矩阵
counts <- read.table(COUNTS_FILE, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, comment.char = "#")
counts <- counts[, 6:ncol(counts)]  # 移除featureCounts的注释列

# 读取metadata
metadata <- read.csv(METADATA_FILE, row.names = 1)

# 确保样本顺序一致
counts <- counts[, rownames(metadata)]

# ========== 创建DESeq对象 ==========
cat("创建DESeq对象...\n")

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ group
)

# 过滤低表达基因
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# ========== 差异分析 ==========
cat("运行差异分析...\n")

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = CONTRAST)

# 排序
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]

# ========== 筛选显著基因 ==========
cat("筛选差异基因...\n")

res_sig <- res %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(padj < PADJ_CUTOFF, abs(log2FoldChange) > LFC_CUTOFF)

cat(sprintf("发现 %d 个显著差异基因\n", nrow(res_sig)))

# ========== 保存结果 ==========
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 保存所有结果
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "all_genes.csv"))

# 保存显著基因
write.csv(res_sig, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "deg_genes.csv"))

# ========== 可视化 ==========
cat("生成图表...\n")

# 1. 火山图
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "volcano.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
EnhancedVolcano(res,
    lab = rownames(res),
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'padj',
    pCutoff = PADJ_CUTOFF,
    FCcutoff = LFC_CUTOFF,
    title = 'Differentially Expressed Genes')
dev.off()

# 2. PCA图
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "pca.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "group") + theme_bw()
dev.off()

# 3. 热图
top_genes <- head(rownames(res_sig), 50)
mat <- assay(vsd)[top_genes, ]
mat <- mat - rowMeans(mat)

png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "heatmap.png"), width = 4000, height = 5000, res = 300)
pheatmap(mat, 
         annotation_col = metadata,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE)
dev.off()

cat("分析完成! 结果保存在:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")

#!/bin/bash
# WES变异检测流程 (GATK)
# 作者: {{AUTHOR}}
# 日期: {{DATE}}

set -e

# ========== 参数设置 ==========
THREADS=8
REF_GENOME="reference/genome.fa"
KNOWN_SITES="reference/dbsnp.vcf"
INPUT_DIR="data/raw"
OUTPUT_DIR="results"
SAMPLE_NAME="sample1"

mkdir -p $OUTPUT_DIR

# ========== 1. 比对 ==========
echo "=== 步骤1: BWA比对 ==="

bwa mem -t $THREADS \
    -R "@RG\tID:${SAMPLE_NAME}\tSM:${SAMPLE_NAME}\tPL:ILLUMINA" \
    $REF_GENOME \
    $INPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R1.fastq.gz \
    $INPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_R2.fastq.gz | \
    samtools sort -o $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.sorted.bam

samtools index $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.sorted.bam

# ========== 2. 标记重复 ==========
echo "=== 步骤2: 标记重复 ==="

gatk MarkDuplicates \
    -I $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.sorted.bam \
    -O $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.dedup.bam \
    -M $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_metrics.txt

samtools index $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.dedup.bam

# ========== 3. BQSR ==========
echo "=== 步骤3: BQSR ==="

gatk BaseRecalibrator \
    -I $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.dedup.bam \
    -R $REF_GENOME \
    --known-sites $KNOWN_SITES \
    -O $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_recal.table

gatk ApplyBQSR \
    -I $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.dedup.bam \
    -R $REF_GENOME \
    --bqsr-recal-file $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_recal.table \
    -O $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.recal.bam

samtools index $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.recal.bam

# ========== 4. 变异检测 ==========
echo "=== 步骤4: HaplotypeCaller ==="

gatk HaplotypeCaller \
    -R $REF_GENOME \
    -I $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}.recal.bam \
    -O $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_raw_variants.vcf

# ========== 5. 变异过滤 ==========
echo "=== 步骤5: 变异过滤 ==="

# SNP过滤
gatk VariantFiltration \
    -R $REF_GENOME \
    -V $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_raw_variants.vcf \
    --filter-expression "QD < 2.0 || MQ < 40.0 || FS > 60.0 || SOR > 3.0" \
    --filter-name "SNP_FILTER" \
    -O $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_filtered.vcf

# 提取PASS变异
bcftools view -f PASS $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_filtered.vcf \
    -o $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_variants_pass.vcf

echo "=== 变异检测完成 ==="
echo "结果文件: $OUTPUT_DIR/${SAMPLE_NAME}_variants_pass.vcf"

# 单细胞RNA-seq分析脚本 (Seurat v5)
# 作者: {{AUTHOR}}
# 日期: {{DATE}}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ========== 参数设置 ==========
DATA_DIR <- "data/raw"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results"
MIN_FEATURES <- 200
MAX_FEATURES <- 2500
MAX_MT_PERCENT <- 5
N_VARIABLE_FEATURES <- 2000
N_PCS <- 30
RESOLUTION <- 0.5

# ========== 创建输出目录 ==========
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ========== 读取数据 ==========
cat("读取数据...\n")

# 10x数据
pbmc <- Read10X(data.dir = DATA_DIR)
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc, project = "scRNA")

# ========== 质量控制 ==========
cat("质量控制...\n")

# 计算线粒体比例
seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^MT-")

# 可视化QC指标
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "qc_violin.png"), width = 4000, height = 2000, res = 300)
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
        ncol = 3)
dev.off()

# 过滤
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj, 
                     subset = nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES & 
                              nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES & 
                              percent.mt < MAX_MT_PERCENT)

cat(sprintf("过滤后细胞数: %d\n", ncol(seurat_obj)))

# ========== 标准化 ==========
cat("标准化...\n")

seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj, nfeatures = N_VARIABLE_FEATURES)
seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)

# ========== 降维 ==========
cat("降维...\n")

seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj, npcs = 50)

# ElbowPlot选择PC数量
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "elbow_plot.png"), width = 3000, height = 2000, res = 300)
ElbowPlot(seurat_obj, ndims = 50)
dev.off()

seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(seurat_obj, dims = 1:N_PCS)
seurat_obj <- RunTSNE(seurat_obj, dims = 1:N_PCS)

# ========== 聚类 ==========
cat("聚类...\n")

seurat_obj <- FindNeighbors(seurat_obj, dims = 1:N_PCS)
seurat_obj <- FindClusters(seurat_obj, resolution = RESOLUTION)

# ========== 可视化 ==========
cat("可视化...\n")

# UMAP
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "umap_clusters.png"), width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 300)
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
dev.off()

# ========== Marker基因 ==========
cat("鉴定Marker基因...\n")

markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, 
                          only.pos = TRUE, 
                          min.pct = 0.25,
                          logfc.threshold = 0.25)

top_markers <- markers %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  top_n(10, avg_log2FC)

write.csv(markers, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "all_markers.csv"))
write.csv(top_markers, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "top_markers.csv"))

# 热图
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "marker_heatmap.png"), width = 5000, height = 4000, res = 300)
DoHeatmap(seurat_obj, features = top_markers$gene, size = 3) + NoLegend()
dev.off()

# ========== 保存对象 ==========
saveRDS(seurat_obj, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "seurat_object.rds"))

cat("分析完成! 结果保存在:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")

# GEO数据挖掘脚本
# 作者: {{AUTHOR}}
# 日期: {{DATE}}

library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# ========== 参数设置 ==========
GSE_ID <- "GSE12345"  # 替换为目标GSE编号
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results"
GROUP_PATTERN <- c("tumor" = "tumor", "normal" = "normal")  # 样本分组模式

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ========== 下载GEO数据 ==========
cat("下载GEO数据:", GSE_ID, "\n")

gset <- getGEO(GSE_ID, GSEMatrix = TRUE, getGPL = FALSE)
expr <- exprs(gset[[1]])
pdata <- pData(gset[[1]])

cat(sprintf("数据维度: %d 基因 x %d 样本\n", nrow(expr), ncol(expr)))

# ========== 样本分组 ==========
cat("样本分组...\n")

# 根据样本名称分组（根据实际情况调整）
group <- ifelse(grepl("tumor|cancer|T", pdata$title, ignore.case = TRUE), 
                "tumor", "normal")
group <- factor(group, levels = c("normal", "tumor"))

# ========== 差异分析 ==========
cat("差异分析...\n")

design <- model.matrix(~0 + group)
colnames(design) <- c("normal", "tumor")

fit <- lmFit(expr, design)
contrast <- makeContrasts(tumor - normal, levels = design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# 获取差异基因
diff_genes <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf, p.value = 0.05, lfc = 1)
diff_genes <- diff_genes[order(diff_genes$logFC), ]

cat(sprintf("发现 %d 个差异基因\n", nrow(diff_genes)))

write.csv(diff_genes, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "diff_genes.csv"))

# ========== 富集分析 ==========
cat("富集分析...\n")

# 转换基因ID
gene_symbols <- rownames(diff_genes)
gene_entrez <- bitr(gene_symbols, 
                    fromType = "SYMBOL", 
                    toType = "ENTREZID", 
                    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO富集
go_enrich <- enrichGO(gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                      ont = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# KEGG富集
kegg_enrich <- enrichKEGG(gene = gene_entrez$ENTREZID,
                          organism = "hsa",
                          pvalueCutoff = 0.05)

# 保存富集结果
write.csv(as.data.frame(go_enrich), file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "go_enrichment.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_enrich), file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "kegg_enrichment.csv"))

# 可视化
png(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "go_dotplot.png"), width = 4000, height = 4000, res = 300)
dotplot(go_enrich, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle("GO Enrichment")
dev.off()

cat("分析完成! 结果保存在:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
